notes: Searches: all 6 used (hard cap reached). Fetches: 31 of 60. Verified records are only the two Spotlight Card Show editions, both from the organizer's own pages (spotlightcardshow.com, published Oct 12 2026, with years written on the subpages). Honolulu Oct 24 and 25 2026 is 3 days out. Spotlight Seattle Dec 12 and 13 2026 is new to the atlas. Washington: most WA shows found are listing-only (treasurehunter.show and thecardshopfinder.com are never-fetch sites, so only their URLs were copied into leads_only). Oregon: no verified upcoming Salem or Eugene organizer page; the Salem Scottish Rite series (Nov 22 and Dec 6 2026) is the best candidate for a series record once the organizer is found. Oregon Expo Center and the Eugene city calendar returned 403. Alaska: no card show for 2026 or 2027 found. Two searches, the Card Shop Finder Alaska pages (no events) and the anchorage.net events calendar (no card shows) all came back empty. Hawaii: Blaisdell Arena calendar has no card shows listed (page shows only a farmers market notice); Hawaii Convention Center calendar unreachable. Paradise Card Show (Nov 22 2026) is unconfirmed: the listed venue site is not a Honolulu venue. Spotlight vendor counts differ between pages (Seattle: 250+ on the subpage, 275+ on the lookbook page; Honolulu: 450+ vendors on the page, not table counts), so no table counts were recorded. Honolulu venue on the organizer page is Hawaii Convention Center, while the June 2026 debut was at Blaisdell Arena. An Eventeny Washington listing page was read: it shows only Maximum Card Show Bellevue dates (covered elsewhere) with no years on the cards. Out of scope or covered elsewhere and skipped: Front Row Portland (Oct 3 to 4, Dec 12 to 13 2026, June 13 to 14), Maximum Card Show Portland (July 25 to 26, Oct 24 2026, Jan 23 to 24 2027). Idaho listings seen (Pick 6 Post Falls, CardCon Coeur d'Alene Nov 7 2026) are outside this region and were not researched. A search summary mentioned an Emerald City Trading Card Convention on Nov 14 and 15 2026 at a Tukwila or Southside conference center, but no page URL was retrieved, so it is not recorded; a wave with a Seattle-area or Tukwila lookup should check it.
